'''District 52''' was one of the vertically-stacked levels of the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]], the capital city of [[Zakuul]] and the [[Eternal Empire]]. The highest level of all, it housed the [[Overwatch]] command center and contained the point of entry to the [[Eternal Throne]] room.<ref name="TOR:TS" /> Those living on this level occasionally boasted of their proximity to the Emperor, although its living conditions were identical to every other district.
